doc_friction.issue: 'The spin error was there without the jitter' estimated a 0.1 ms simulator run at about ten times the run time; it took 7% longer, because the firmware's own work dominates a build, not the plant's physics.

The same section framed the remaining floor as simulator coarseness or a missing model term; on the first-order plant the model equals the simulator's physics, so the fit's search was the third candidate it did not list (and the answer).
